reviews.text: October 4th, World Animal and Veterinarian Day. I dedicate this day to Vetolivais Dr. Pedro Alenquer. The veterinarian who seems like a pediatrician. Thank you for everything and so much more.
Let's just say I wouldn't want any other veterinarian for my dogs. Dr. Pedro is an excellent professional...5 stars!
A very good doctor. He saved the life of my Jack Russell, who weighed only 700 grams at 3 months old (the result of unscrupulous breeders), and I can say the same about my cat, who was poorly spayed.
We are traveling from the UK and needed an appointment. We got one the same day and had a great experience. Pedro was very friendly, helpful and was amazing with our over exciteable dog.
I called with a question and was met with extreme arrogance.

Excellent veterinarian, truly very good. Attentive to detail and focused on the animal's well-being, without recommending unnecessary hospitalization just to later investigate and medicate indiscriminately like others out there. Excellent, highly recommended!
Excellent doctor. Very professional and caring with animals. I recommend this clinic without any doubt.
Dr. Pedro is the best in the world!
I love it and highly recommend it. The veterinarian is super attentive and available.

I've been searching for a veterinary clinic with good service for a long time, and this clinic offered me great kindness from the moment I arrived until Dr. Pedro's exceptional service. He explained everything our dog, Pandora, needed for a peaceful old age. I highly recommend them, especially the doctor's availability should Pandora need any urgent care! I felt very safe and don't need to look any further; I've finally found the right place for my dear old lady!! Thank you all for your kindness and care!
Friendly staff, but appointments are required; no walk-ins. Consultations are quite expensive, with prices above average. In any case, the service was good.
Dr. Pedro is the best veterinarian I've ever met.
